description: This file defines an object 'OpenClawCanvasA2UIAction' containing utility functions for processing UI actions in an Android app. It includes methods for extracting action names from JSON objects, sanitizing string tags, formatting agent messages, and dispatching JavaScript events with action status.

classes.name: OpenClawCanvasA2UIAction
classes.description: Singleton object holding utility functions for handling UI actions related to the Canvas A2 in the OpenClaw Android application.

methods.name: extractActionName
methods.description: Extracts the 'name' or 'action' field from a JsonObject representing user action, returning the trimmed string or null if neither is present.

methods.name: sanitizeTagValue
methods.description: Sanitizes a string value by trimming, replacing spaces with underscores, and replacing non-permitted characters with underscores.

methods.name: formatAgentMessage
methods.description: Creates a formatted string to represent an agent message, including sanitized fields and optional context JSON.

methods.name: jsDispatchA2UIActionStatus
methods.description: Produces a JavaScript snippet to dispatch a custom event indicating the status of an A2 UI action, with success or error details.

methods.name: jsonStringLiteral
methods.description: Serializes a raw string into a JSON string literal, escaping Unicode line separator characters.
